name: Partially hydrolyzed guar gum (PHGG)
summary: PHGG is a prebiotic fiber derived from guar gum with RCT support in IBS, constipation, and glycemic control. It is better tolerated for gas than psyllium, making it a practical alternative for fiber-sensitive users.
description: Canonical Partially hydrolyzed guar gum (PHGG) research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until trial-specific efficacy, formulation, dose, longer-term safety, and outcome-boundary evidence has passed the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: prebiotic fiber; IBS symptoms; constipation; glycemic control; gut microbiome
